passages.quote:
This guidance sets out the process for ensuring bulk transfer arrangements are in place when an NHS organisation is re-tendering for the provision of services. This will involve staff transferring back into the NHS Pension Scheme via the terms of New Fair Deal.

This guidance supplements HM Treasury’s detailed New Fair Deal guidance.
